purpose: Lossless Git packaging of existing cloud-reviewed development candidates; not an authoring or Gold acceptance schema.
encoding: UTF-8, no BOM; JSONL canonical records separated by LF
record_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False).encode(UTF-8), no trailing LF
preservation: All candidate, answer and QA objects unchanged. Upstream file-level bindings preserved as historical strings, not rewritten to claim local file equivalence.
acceptance_scope: development candidates; not frozen Gold; no new semantic review
